title: Floral Organogenesis: Whorls, ABC/ABCE Identity and Genetic Control
word_count_method: Count whitespace-delimited words from saved p.teaching-prose only, stripping markup/entities. Excludes headings, questions, answers, tables, SVGs/captions, revision and references. Visible article count excludes SVG and zoom buttons.

coverage_matrix.comparative_scope: comparative; detailed Antirrhinum mutant comparisons reserved for 5.D.11

dimensions.E: molecular-tests and feedback; binding thermodynamics and growth mechanics, no fabricated biochemical constants
dimensions.M: comparative applications; clinical applications not applicable

review_pass_1: Internal scientific/syllabus review: verified revised and separate CSIR Unit 5.D pages and mirrored MP SET p.4; checked selected primary and review records for ABC, SEP redundancy, D function, AP2/miR172, AP3/PI, SUP boundary, LFY/WUS/AG/KNU and MADS complexes. Distinguished idealized A/C antagonism from real named-gene alleles and ag reiteration; separated whorl identity from nested ovule identity, proliferation, fertility, and reporter activity. Independently recomputed six examples and quantitative questions.
review_pass_2: Internal teaching/examination review: reordered 19 sections for progression, added anatomical diagram, explicit misconception cause/exam cue, graph dataset, section-level evidence, glossary and recall; checked 52 answers against options and 13 of each answer position. Saved-text comparator 5.D.02 contains 13,733 teaching words and 120 paragraphs; zero exact paragraph overlap. Reviewed draft reader architecture, tag nesting, unique IDs, anchors, SVG descriptions and zoom targets; JS copied from established reader with neighbor strings corrected.

quality.assessment: Internal editorial judgment, not external expert peer review.
deductions: Selected primary records and reviews rather than exhaustive full-text verification; simplified classical model with caveats.
Some necessary conceptual recurrence in evidence and interpretation.
Illustrative hypothetical datasets and binding parameters, not experimental measurements.
Original question difficulty not externally calibrated; some straightforward Part B distractors.
Static markup and reader architecture checks only; no independent browser or assistive-technology test.

validation.comparator: 5.D.02, 13733 teaching words, 120 paragraphs; no exact paragraph overlap

limitations: Current MPPSC primary-host syllabus not independently verified; archived 2024 copy used.
Selected primary abstracts and reviews, not exhaustive full-text verification or external peer review.
No independent interactive browser, mobile, screen-reader or separate script-parser test; static reader checks only.
Pages deployment and live verification are separate.
